dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you ever seen someone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I can't really say. There are way too many people coming in and out of Hanamizaka. And I'm usually the only one on duty. How can I possibly remember that?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: Gee, can't people just do their job properly...
